title: APAC 2026 — travel & expenses scratchpad
content:
Quick notes + checklist for APAC trip (MLAPAC 2026) — working doc / receipts scratchpad

Trip overview:
- Conference: MLAPAC 2026 (Mar 10-12)
- Location: Singapore Conference Centre (SCC)
- Purpose: speak on low-latency inference, support Redwood booth, meet customers/partners
- Attendees from Redwood: Jordan Smith (me), Aisha Khan (DS), Ravi Patel (sales lead)

Important deadlines:
- Expense upload deadline to Finance (reimburse): submit receipts + forms by 2026-03-05 (firm)
- Corporate card reconciliation due 2026-03-07
- Booth vendor invoice due on-site (pay to vendor) — capture invoice and attach to Jira JIRA-7891

Pre-trip to-dos:
- Confirm flight + seat (done) — flight details in travel email. Note: depart SFO 03/08, arrive SIN 03/10 local morning (long layover in TPE)
- Confirm hotel reservation at Marina Bay Sands — check-in 03/10, check-out 03/13. Reservation #: MBS-44211 (booked on company AMEX)
- Local SIM / eSIM: buy on arrival at Changi or pre-order. Add to per-diem if personal purchase.
- Apply for visa? US -> Singapore no visa required for short business trip (checked)

Expense guidelines / reminders:
- Use company Amex (ending 1234) for all vendor/booth charges where possible. If vendor insists on local bank transfer, capture invoice and ask finance for wire instructions.
- Personal meals: per-diem cap SGD 80/day. Keep itemized receipts.
- Ground transport: use Grab when possible; keep receipts or take screenshot of trip in app (date/time + cost).
- Taxis: only if Grab not available — must include receipt and reason.
- Misc (SIM, adapters): reimbursable — attach receipt and short note.

Estimated expenses (ballpark):
- Flights (SFO-SIN roundtrip): $2,500 (company-paid)
- Hotel (MBS) 3 nights: $900
- Booth (vendor on-site setup & drayage): SGD 4,200 (~$3,050) — vendor: Pacific Expo Services
- Local transport & meals (per person): SGD 450 (~$330)
- Misc (SIM, taxis, supplies): $150
- Total (est): ~$7,000 (company + reimburseables)

Vendor contacts (booth / AV / logistics):
- Pacific Expo Services (booth build / drayage / electricity)
  - Contact: Melissa Tan
  - Email: melissa.tan@pacificexposg.com
  - Phone: +65 9123 4456
  - Contract/Quote #: PES-0214-RW (save invoice PDF)
- Audio/Visual partner: SoundWorks Asia
  - Contact: Ken Liu
  - Email: ken.liu@soundworks.asia
  - On-site rep: Ken (arrives 03/09 for setup)

Booth notes / checklist:
- Booth #12 layout: 3m x 6m island. Needs power (2 x 15A) and internet (ethernet + wifi)
- Tablecloth (Redwood logo) — ordered via office-admin (order ref: ORD-332)
- Pop-up banner x2 (deliver to booth on 03/09 AM) — bring backup banner to carry-on
- Demo laptop: ensure VPN access + model container image pre-pulled (see runbook link in Confluence)
- Local signage with QR code linking to hosted demo token page

Conference schedule (high level):
- 03/10 (Day 1): keynotes AM; poster sessions PM; evening networking reception (must be at booth by 6pm)
- 03/11 (Day 2): my talk 11:30-12:00 (Room B); panel 15:00-15:45; sponsor dinner 19:00 (RSVP with Ravi)
- 03/12 (Day 3): workshops; customer meetings all day; tear-down 17:00

Talk logistics:
- Talk title: "Serving LLMs at scale: latency, cost, and graceful degradation"
- Slides final deadline: 2026-03-01 (upload to conference portal) — DONE (v1) — finalize v2 with Aisha
- AV needs: projector + clicker; practice run 03/10 09:00 in Room B
- Speaker travel stipend: claim with speaker form (link in linked_artifacts)

On-site finance / receipts process:
- Keep original receipts for all physical purchases — stamp if vendor provides
- For cash tips, note amount and reason on a small note and attach to expense report
- Use Expensify (company account) to scan and tag receipts. Policy category: TRAVEL-APAC-2026. Attach currency conversion rate screenshot if not USD.
- For booth vendor invoice, confirm VAT/GST treatment. If GST charged, finance may be able to reclaim — mark invoice as "taxable" and attach vendor GST registration if provided.

Contacts / quick list:
- On-site Redwood lead: Ravi Patel (mobile: +65 9122 3344)
- Office admin (EMEA/APAC bookings): Priya Desai (pri@redwood.com)
- Finance (expense review): finance-ops@redwood.com, submit ticket JIRA-7891 for high-value vendor payment
- Security / VPN help: infra-support@redwood.com (urgent: use +1 pager if blocked)

Post-trip actions:
- Upload all receipts to Expensify and submit expense report with notes by 2026-03-05
- Confirm booth final invoice reconciliation with Finance and mark paid under JIRA-7891
- Write short trip recap + leads list and drop in #customer-success + paste into Confluence notes page

Notes to self (random):
- Bring spare power adapter (Type G) + USB-C hub; pack presentation remote in carry-on
- Keep printed copies of boarding passes & hotel reservation just in case
- Remember to clear cached demo keys and rotate demo tokens after demo sessions

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Aisha: need the final model image digest for demo (tag: v1.3-rls). Request Aisha to push to prod registry by 03/03.
- Booth electricity: confirm panel placement for power drop (Melissa to confirm by 03/04)
- Sponsor dinner dietary constraints — collect from team (Ravi)

-- end scratchpad --
